description: This file defines a SwiftUI view called AgentEventsWindow that displays a list of agent events retrieved from a shared store. It includes subviews and helper methods for rendering event details, formatting timestamps, and pretty-printing JSON data. The file also contains a preview provider for SwiftUI canvas testing.

classes.name: EventRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view that represents a single event row displaying event details, including stream type, run ID, timestamp, and JSON data.

methods.name: body
methods.description: The view builder that constructs the UI for both AgentEventsWindow and EventRow.

methods.name: tint
methods.description: Determines the background color based on the event's stream.

methods.name: formattedTs
methods.description: Formats the event timestamp into a human-readable string.

methods.name: prettyJSON
methods.description: Converts a dictionary with AnyCodable values into a pretty-printed JSON string.
